sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.PromoCode AS promoCode, p.Name AS name, p.Discount AS discountAmount, p.OrderMinimum AS orderMinimum FROM dbo.ZnodePromotion p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePromotionType t ON t.PromotionTypeId = p.PromotionTypeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal s ON s.PortalId = p.PortalId WHERE t.Name = @promotionTypeName AND s.StoreCode = @store AND p.StartDate <= @now AND p.EndDate >= @now AND p.IsCouponRequired = @couponRequired AND p.OrderMinimum > @zeroAmount AND (@profile IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT m.PromotionProfileMapperId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionProfileMapper m LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeProfile pr ON pr.ProfileId = m.ProfileId WHERE m.PromotionId = p.PromotionId AND (m.ProfileId IS NULL OR pr.ProfileName = @profile))) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.PromoCode = @preferred) ORDER BY p.PromotionId
